description: This PHP class 'LDAPSyncService' manages LDAP synchronization for an HRM system, including fetching LDAP users, creating or updating system users, handling LDAP entries, and ensuring data consistency with employee records.

classes.name: LDAPSyncService
classes.description: Main service class for synchronizing LDAP users with the HR system, handling LDAP queries, user creation, updates, and deletion.

methods.name: getLDAPDao
methods.description: Returns the LDAP Data Access Object, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: getLDAPService
methods.description: Returns the LDAP service instance, initializing and binding it if needed.

methods.name: getLDAPSetting
methods.description: Retrieves LDAP configuration settings, throws exception if not configured.

methods.name: getEmpNumbersWhoHaveManyUsers
methods.description: Fetches employee numbers associated with multiple users.

methods.name: fetchAllLDAPUsers
methods.description: Fetches all LDAP users, handling duplicates and failures.

methods.name: getHashOfLDAPUser
methods.description: Generates a hash for an LDAP user for change detection.

methods.name: createSystemUsers
methods.description: Creates or updates system users based on LDAP data.

methods.name: trySaveEmployee
methods.description: Attempts to save employee data, dispatching events, returns null on failure.

methods.name: warnMultiUserEmployee
methods.description: Logs a warning if an employee has multiple system users.

methods.name: saveEmployee
methods.description: Persists employee data after validation for uniqueness.

methods.name: filterLDAPAuthProvider
methods.description: Filters and returns LDAP type authentication provider from a list.

methods.name: sync
methods.description: Main method to synchronize LDAP users with local system, handling transactions.

methods.name: fetchEntryCollections
methods.description: Fetches LDAP entries based on configured lookup settings.

methods.name: fetchEntryCollection
methods.description: Fetches LDAP entries for a specific lookup setting, with caching.

methods.name: prepareLDAPUserFromEntry
methods.description: Creates LDAPUser object from LDAP entry, with error handling.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attribute value from an LDAP entry.

methods.name: getSearchAttributes
methods.description: Determines LDAP search attributes based on settings.

methods.name: deleteLocalUsersWhoRemovedFromLDAPServer
methods.description: Deletes local users who are no longer present in LDAP.
